all.title: InCoder-32B-Thinking: Industrial Code World Model for Thinking

all.title: AutoMIA: Improved Baselines for Membership Inference Attack via Agentic Self-Exploration
all.summary: AutoMIA is an agentic framework that automates membership inference attacks by dynamically generating and refining logits-level strategies through self-exploration and closed-loop evaluation.

all.title: A Simple Baseline for Streaming Video Understanding
all.summary: A simple sliding-window approach using recent video frames outperforms complex memory-based streaming video understanding methods, revealing trade-offs between real-time perception and long-term memory capabilities.

all.title: VOID: Video Object and Interaction Deletion
all.summary: VOID is a video object removal framework that uses vision-language models and video diffusion models to generate physically plausible scenes by leveraging causal reasoning and counterfactual reasoning.

all.title: Signals: Trajectory Sampling and Triage for Agentic Interactions
all.summary: A signal-based framework for efficiently triaging agentic interaction trajectories by computing low-cost indicators that identify informative samples without impacting online agent behavior.
